proof.notation: p=1-a in(0,1), m0=81, A=(sum_r n_r*r^p)/W. The source-bound m81 failure proves A>m0^p.
proof.new_moment: (A+d^p)/(m0+d)^p after adding exactly W rank-d children and increasing ambient dimension to m0+d.
proof.strict_concavity: For m0,d>0 and0<p<1, (m0+d)^p<m0^p+d^p<A+d^p. Hence the new moment is greater than1 for every positive real d, including all positive integer padding dimensions.
proof.scope: The existing m81 profile and consumer tariff are retained; added common padding requires W rank-d children. Native gauge eligibility is granted and the original idle mass remains priced optimistically at rank57. This excludes this padding family only, not a redesigned supplier, consumer, or idle geometry.
